name: CMIP6 multi-model ensemble
resolution: Regridded to 1° × 1°, 3-day means, historical (1950–2014) and SSP3-7.0 (2015–2100)
access: CMIP6 coupled models outputs are available from the ESGF portal (https://aims2.llnl.gov/search/cmip6/ )

scales.note: 12 CMIP6 models regridded to 1x1 degree and 3-day means spanning historical (1950–2014) and SSP3-7.0 (2015–2100).
